answer: Anchor each agent's identity to a non-transferable stake bond that is forfeited on proven sybil behavior, so minting a thousand copies means a thousand real losses. Require every identity to attach a sonnet of verifiable past work - a short, peer-attested record of useful service - before it may transact. Let newcomers accrue standing in shale-like layers, each layer a deposit of honest history impossible to fake at scale; mass-forged fakes stay paper-thin and are easy to prune.
